items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room, like-for-like replacement
items.rationale: Lightning overvoltage (2.3.3) damaged a fixed unit about 7 m from the hob, so the 5 m climate-equipment exclusion in 2.3.10(c) does not apply. Like-for-like replacement is payable under 7.1.1(c)/7.1.9(a), taken at the upper customary price.

items.description: Air conditioning unit - kitchen, within 5 m of hob
items.rationale: Climate-control equipment within 5 m of a cooking appliance is conclusively excluded from overvoltage cover under 2.3.10(c). No kitchen climate endorsement was taken, and Case 28 also came out at 0.
Installation labour follows its principal item under 7.1.9(c)/7.1.11, but this line type was declined in all 4 earlier cases. The probability of payment is therefore low.
This is an ancillary charge to an excluded principal item (2.3.10(c)), so it is not covered under 7.1.11. It was also declined in all earlier cases.
An equivalent support whose predecessor was scorched and cannot be reused is part of the replacement under 7.1.9(b). It is not a decorative element under 7.1.10.
Carriage is apportioned under 7.1.11, so only the living-room unit's share of roughly half the line is payable. This depends on the principal item being covered.
